title: Best tour guide ever
text: Giovanna was fantastic. Her knowledge of the Sagrada Família was incredible. So knowledgeable and made the tour so special. She was very personal and friendly. I highly recommend her.
author: georgehO6386SG

title: Amazing guide for family with 5 & 7 y/o boys
text:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Alessia. She was amazing with our two young boys! She immediately got down on their level, brought books for them, focused on them throughout the tour, and found ways to make Sagrada Família interactive and interesting for them while still giving the adults an incredible experience.

She was also incredibly thoughtful about our experience as a family, taking photos of us together, showing us exactly where to stand to see special details, navigating everything seamlessly, and even making sure we knew where to find air conditioning and vending machines

title: Great info for kids and adults!
text: Caterina is a wonderful tour guide who presented the details of La Sagrada Familia in a way that was engaging for a 6-year-old and the adults. We gained a lot of information through this experience and will remember it for many years. I highly recommend this tour and tour guide! Thank you!
author: Rebecca S

title: Top Rate Tour Guide
text: What a wonderful experience in understanding the cathedral! Our guide Valentina P was an excellent tour guide for children. She answered questions with precision and understanding of children’s ages. I would recommend this tour guide to anyone who is traveling with a family. Her pleasant personality and knowledge was exceptional thank you we appreciate your time and expertise.

title: Family Friendly Visit to Sagrada Familia
text: We did a 1.5 hour family friendly tour of Sagrada Família through LivTours. Our guide Valentina P was so friendly and knowledgeable. She did a great job of engaging our kids and making it fun for them! Highly recommend!
